items.title: Show HN: Beautiful Markdown rendering in your terminal
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN, I’ve been cobbling together a tool to read beautifully formatted markdown without leaving my terminal.
Lime renders markdown in the terminal with actual formatting - big headers, syntax highlighted code, mermaid diagrams, all drawn using Ghostty’s Kitty graphics protocol support.
It picks up your terminal’s native theme and you can jump between headings, pull up a table of contents to search and jump to sections of your document.
It’s macOS and Ghostty for now, the document lives in scro

items.title: Show HN: FOSS browser-based visual Kegel trainer for men
items.contentSnippet:
Hey, HN. Long time reader; first submission.
I read HN daily and greatly enjoy looking at the projects that people are working on. I find the single-page websites particularly fun and decided to make one of my own.
KegelTrainer.net is a visual Kegel trainer for men with configurable settings based on clinically recommended protocols. It’s ready to go instantly with no login.
I made this tool because I do Kegels myself as a man of a certain age and wanted an easy way to track hold times and reps.

items.contentSnippet:
